```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 3, "due_date": 463, "weight": 7},
    1: {"processing_time": 22, "due_date": 416, "weight": 4},
    2: {"processing_time": 66, "due_date": 403, "weight": 4},
    3: {"processing_time": 92, "due_date": 603, "weight": 10},
    4: {"processing_time": 43, "due_date": 530, "weight": 8},
    5: {"processing_time": 46, "due_date": 506, "weight": 2},
    6: {"processing_time": 61, "due_date": 619, "weight": 5},
    7: {"processing_time": 54, "due_date": 481, "weight": 9},
    8: {"processing_time": 36, "due_date": 261, "weight": 6},
    9: {"processing_time": 9, "due_date": 131, "weight": 8},
    10: {"processing_time": 37, "due_date": 90, "weight": 10},
    11: {"processing_time": 10, "due_date": 407, "weight": 7},
    12: {"processing_time": 96, "due_date": 561, "weight": 8},
    13: {"processing_time": 36, "due_date": 280, "weight": 10},
    14: {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 356, "weight": 6},
    15: {"processing_time": 1, "due_date": 223, "weight": 3},
    16: {"processing_time": 64, "due_date": 252, "weight": 9},
    17: {"processing_time": 35, "due_date": 104, "weight": 2},
    18: {"processing_time": 63, "due_date": 568, "weight": 7},
    19: {"processing_time": 54, "due_date": 392, "weight": 10},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
